sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Fetch own call review handler
sections.what: Returns the review of one locked call for the signed-in fan, including grade, rating change and receipts.
sections.why: Likely reason: fans review their own calls after the outcome is known.
sections.watch_out: Ownership is enforced only inside the lab service, so that check must stay there.

summary: Returns the review of one call the signed-in fan has locked: the grade, the rating change, the reveal and the receipts.
purpose: Shows fans how their call turned out.
why: The comment ties this to the feature code F-L-03 in the project plan.
how: 1) Confirms sign-in. 2) Reads the moment id from the address. 3) Calls the review function for this user and call, and returns the result as JSON.
inputs: A GET request with the moment id in the address. The user comes from the session.
outputs: A JSON review of the call.
risks: The route only passes ids on, so the review service must make sure a fan sees only their own calls.
debug: If a review is missing, check the review function in the lab service and that the call belongs to the signed-in user.
